humanParticipantResearch.reason: Project policy; never present synthetic personas or automated checks as real participant research.

validationPolicy.requiredWebVerification: Actual browser interaction and applicable automated accessibility checks remain required; release uses configured Chromium, Firefox, WebKit matrix.

optionalTargets.native: Required only when explicitly declared as a supported target.
optionalTargets.offline: Required only when explicitly declared as a supported capability.

commandContract.argv: Nonempty array of literal arguments, executed without a shell.
commandContract.cwd: Relative existing path within target repository.
commandContract.expectedExitCodes: Must be [0]. A wrapper asserts intentional negative application outcomes and returns zero only when assertions hold; every nonzero gate-command exit fails.
commandContract.coversAcceptanceIds: Existing case IDs actually asserted by this command.
commandContract.evidenceArtifacts: Relative paths produced by execution, existing after run, nonsecret, and hashed in receipt.
